question: When docs/fees.md and fees.py disagree, which one governs?

options.doc-governs: docs/fees.md governs; change fees.py to match it
options.code-governs: fees.py governs; leave the code as it is
options.rate-only: use the document's percent and ignore its waiver

gold_verification: The gold option is the one the hidden acceptance tests accept. It is not a model's opinion. code-governs and rate-only fail the waiver or the percent check.
gold_source: docs/fees.md says it is the source of truth: no fee within 7 days of delivery, otherwise 15 percent rounded half up to the cent.
